signup.title: Sign up
signup.subtitle: Enter your email — we'll send a code to confirm registration.

terms.before: By creating an account, you agree to the
terms.after: . We'll occasionally send you account-related emails.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Enter your email or phone — we'll send the sign-in code to your email.

signinRecovery.title: Recovery sign-in
signinRecovery.enterLogin: Enter the email or phone linked to your account.
signinRecovery.twoFaOnly: Requires 2FA to be on: your password or authenticator code, plus a recovery code.
signinRecovery.emailSigninLink: Back to the main sign-in method

confirm.title: Confirmation

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email. Enter it to continue.
hint.PHONE: We sent a code to your phone. Enter it to continue.
hint.TOTP: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
hint.RECOVERY: Enter one of your one-time recovery codes.

confirm.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but signing in failed. No need to confirm again — just try once more.
confirm.lastResend: Note: that was the last resend of the code.
confirm.exhaustedAttempts: Wrong code, no attempts left. Request a new code.
confirm.exhaustedExpired: The code has expired. Request a new code.
confirm.deadEnd: You've run out of entry attempts and resends. Start signing in again.
confirm.deadEndNoResend: You've run out of entry attempts. Start signing in again.
confirm.deadEndExpired: The time to confirm has run out and there are no resends left. Start signing in again.
confirm.deadEndExpiredNoResend: The time to confirm has run out. Start signing in again.
confirm.invalidated: This operation can no longer be completed. Start signing in again.

password.title: Set a password

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — it confirms that you are the one setting the password.

password.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the password setup with. Start it again from the settings.
password.awaitingFinish: The code was accepted, but 2FA could not be turned on. No need to confirm again — just retry.
password.invalidated: This password setup can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

recoveryCodes.title: Reissue recovery codes

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email — the reissue starts with it.
hint.PASSWORD: Enter your password: the reissue replaces the code set itself, so it asks for your 2FA method as well.
hint.TOTP: Enter the code from your authenticator app: the reissue replaces the code set itself, so it asks for your 2FA method as well.

recoveryCodes.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm the reissue with. Start it again from the settings.
recoveryCodes.awaitingFinish: The confirmation was accepted, but the codes could not be issued. No need to confirm again — just retry.
recoveryCodes.invalidated: This reissue can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

disable2fa.title: Turn 2FA off

hint.EMAIL: We sent a code to your email: once 2FA is off, the account rests on your mailbox alone, so you have to prove you own it.
hint.PASSWORD: Enter your password — or switch and enter one of your recovery codes.
hint.TOTP: Enter the code from your authenticator app — or switch and enter one of your recovery codes.
hint.RECOVERY: Enter one of your single-use recovery codes.

disable2fa.deadEnd: There is nothing left to confirm turning 2FA off. Start it again from the settings.
disable2fa.awaitingFinish: The confirmation was accepted, but 2FA could not be turned off. No need to confirm again — just retry.
disable2fa.invalidated: Turning 2FA off can no longer be completed. Start it again from the settings.

password.title: Set a password
password.lead: The password becomes your 2FA method: after the code we send, signing in will ask for it as well. Next step — confirmation by a code.
password.copyFailed: Could not copy the password — save it by hand.
password.generateFailed: Could not generate a password — try again or come up with your own.
password.conflict: 2FA is already on — a new password can only be set after turning it off.

codes.title: Recovery codes
codes.warning: Save the codes now: we will not show them again, and reloading the page loses them.
codes.lead: Each code works once. Use it instead of your password or authenticator code when you cannot reach them.
codes.leadReissued: The set has been reissued — the old codes no longer work. Each code works once and is used instead of your password or authenticator code when you cannot reach them.
codes.doneHint: The button turns on once the codes are copied or downloaded.
codes.copyFailed: Could not copy the codes — save them by hand or download the file.
codes.downloadFailed: Could not download the file — copy the codes or save them by hand.
codes.goneOnce: Recovery codes are shown once, and that showing is already closed — not even we can restore the list.
codes.goneReissue: If you did not save them, reissue the set: the old codes stop working and you get a new one.
codes.goneNo2fa: Recovery codes come with 2FA, and yours is off — there is nothing to reissue. Turn 2FA on, and a new set is issued with it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.recoveryCodesEmpty: No recovery codes left — reissue them
profile.recoveryCodesLast: One recovery code left — reissue now
profile.tzUnsupported: your browser does not know this zone, dates are shown in the device time zone

NONE.title: Account is not protected by 2FA
NONE.hint: Signing in is confirmed by the code we send alone

PASSWORD.title: Sign-in is confirmed by a password
PASSWORD.hint: An authenticator app is stronger — its code changes every 30 seconds

TOTP.title: Account is protected by 2FA
TOTP.hint: Sign-in is confirmed by an authenticator app

settings.title: Settings
settings.langHint: Language of emails and server messages. The interface language is switched in the header.
settings.osZoneHint: Your zone is {{zone}}; it is not in the list. Pick “Auto” and the server will choose the closest one.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Information shown may differ from them for a while — to apply them instantly, sign in again.
settings.substituted: The closest available zone was saved: {{zone}} — its time differs from yours.

twoFa.title: Two-factor protection

lead.NONE: Signing in is confirmed by the code we send alone. 2FA adds one more step to it — a password or a code from an app.
lead.PASSWORD: Signing in is confirmed by the code we send and your password.
lead.TOTP: Signing in is confirmed by the code we send and a code from your authenticator app.

password.name: Password
password.how: Asked on every sign-in — after the code we send
password.plus: Nothing to install: works on any device
password.minus: Never changes — once leaked, 2FA stops protecting

totp.name: Authenticator app
totp.how: An app on your phone shows a code that changes every 30 seconds
totp.plus: The code lives on your device only and burns out fast
totp.minus: Needs a phone with the app; lose it and you sign in with a recovery code

twoFa.codesPromise: Turning 2FA on issues recovery codes — a spare way in if the password or the phone is lost. They are shown exactly once.
twoFa.changeHint: Changing the 2FA method — switching to the other one or setting a new password — is only possible after turning 2FA off. Turning it off is confirmed by the code we send and your current password (or a recovery code), and the next time you turn it on you get new recovery codes.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.terminateAll: Terminate all sessions in this workspace
sessions.confirmText: All listed sessions on other devices ({{n}}) will be closed.
sessions.noRealms: You don't belong to any workspace — nothing to show.
sessions.closeError: Could not close the sessions. Please try again.
